protocol_amendment.reason: Guard against the tautology that an identity-like K preserves every coordinate support.

estimands.unmodified_K_closure: P K (I-P) leakage without changing K
estimands.posthoc_restricted_prediction: P K P; an evaluation restriction, not a learned operator
estimands.fitted_local_maps: not fit and not evaluated in this experiment
estimands.activity_change_leakage: ||z P K (I-P)|| / ||z P (K-I)||, aggregated by activity
estimands.family_residuals: global, projected-global, source-gated, and posthoc-restricted latent residuals
estimands.operator_differentiation: pairwise cosine and symmetric normalized Frobenius distances; guard only

decision_branches.strong_direct_sum: All strong gates pass; claim approximate invariant support-specific laws, subject to dense specificity control.
decision_branches.partial_closure: Coverage and closure core pass but residual or differentiation guard fails; claim invariant charts only, not distinct local laws.
decision_branches.failed: Matched-null closure core fails; do not claim that raw global K decomposes into support-specific laws.
decision_branches.invalid: Coverage fails; only allowed diagnostic expansion is 256 trajectories, with all support thresholds unchanged.

dossier_contract.required_distinction: Report raw K closure, change-normalized raw K closure, post-hoc PKP prediction, and fitted local maps as separate estimands.
dossier_contract.claim_guard: No invariant-law claim may pass when P(K-I) has zero activity or when any change-normalized strong gate fails.

conditional_dense_tanh.mask_definition: For each paired state, dense top-k uses k equal to that state's sparse F_abs cardinality.
conditional_dense_tanh.family_and_null_protocol: Identical split, Jaccard threshold, persistent regime, and coordinate-permutation null; no threshold tuning.
